# go-music-dl AI API

Every operation uses the existing go-music-dl route; there are no parallel AI search, playlist, source-switch, download, or library routes.

Start:

- `GET {base}/api/ai/index`
- `GET {base}/search?q=周杰伦&type=song&sources=qq&sources=netease`

Discover:

- Rankings: `GET {base}/toplists`
- Ranked songs: `GET {base}/toplist_songs?source=...&toplist_id=...`
- Playlist categories: `GET {base}/playlist_categories`
- Category playlists: `GET {base}/category_playlists?source=...&category_id=...`

Details:

- Playlist: `GET {base}/playlist?id=...&source=...`
- Album: `GET {base}/album?id=...&source=...`

Downloads:

- Source switch: `GET {base}/switch_source?name=...&artist=...&source=...&target=...`
- Resolution check: `GET {base}/inspect`
- Audio file: `GET {base}/download?...`
- Lyrics: `GET {base}/lyric`
- Queue status: `GET {base}/api/downloads/queue`
- Enqueue songs: `POST {base}/api/downloads/queue`
- Enqueue a complete container: `POST {base}/api/downloads/queue/container`

Health:

- Health: `GET {base}/healthz`

`{base}` defaults to `/music`. The runtime index is the source of truth for parameters. Existing search, playlist, album, ranking, and category routes return the normal rendered page. Preserve a song's `extra` object because some platforms require it for downloads or lyrics. Writes must send `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest`. Do not expose cookies, login, or configuration routes to an AI client.
